what: Content -> Shoppable video -> All clips, the two-column clip editor. Measured in Chromium 1194 by tests/browser/lane-v5-editor-cols.mjs against a throwaway admin preview, at 390px and 1280px.
how: Column counts are getComputedStyle(row).gridTemplateColumns -- the tracks the stylesheet resolved -- not positions read off rectangles. The upload figures are whatever the screen had put on the page at each sample, and the screen puts nothing there but its own xhr.upload.onprogress numbers.
